column1: # A mod this profile ships (BuiltinMods.java; android/README.md "Mods (exefs patches)"). The launcher shows it as a switch in the game's settings and copies
# exefs/ into <Switch2>/Mods/<title ID>/<folder> when it is turned on. Keys:
#   android_default  on or off: what a launcher that has never been told installs (on: copied in at the launcher's start, once per game)
#   check            module, offset, the original bytes the patch replaces (hex): dm/tools/tests/test_profile_mods.py checks them against a dump when it has one
